evals.prompt: We changed an API route and a shared client type. Tell me whether this release is ready to publish.
evals.expected_output: Runs or requests generated-client, typecheck, relevant tests, workflow/preview, and security/release gates; does not infer GO from one passing test.

assertions.name: checks contract freshness
assertions.description: Requires generated-client verification when API contract or generated artifacts changed.

assertions.name: requires evidence
assertions.description: Reports command-level evidence and gives NO-GO for missing or failed required checks.

assertions.name: checks preview path
assertions.description: Verifies the browser-facing workflow and proxied preview, not localhost alone.

evals.prompt: A release adds a data heal and changes sync merge logic. Prepare the release decision without touching production data.
evals.expected_output: Identifies live heal impact, invokes sync safety checks, preserves destructive-test isolation, and stops on unresolved failures.

assertions.name: surfaces live-data impact
assertions.description: Names the startup heal and explains that stored live data will change.

assertions.name: covers sync risks
assertions.description: Requires sync/reset/stamp evidence for sync changes.

assertions.name: protects production
assertions.description: Rejects destructive tests against production or shared operational databases.
